Al-Khatib al-Baghdadi.question: History of _____ or Madīnat as-Salām ('City of Peace') and Appendix of Scholars - 23 volumes
Al-Khatib al-Baghdadi.fact: History of Baghdad or Madīnat as-Salām ('City of Peace') and Appendix of Scholars - 23 volumes.

Al-Khatib al-Baghdadi.subject: Indian Archaeology & Epigraphy
Al-Khatib al-Baghdadi.question: Al-Asma’ al-Mubhama ("_____"), identifying those mentioned anonymously in hadiths or hadith chains
Al-Khatib al-Baghdadi.fact: Al-Asma’ al-Mubhama ("Anonymous Mentions"), identifying those mentioned anonymously in hadiths or hadith chains.

Al-Khatib al-Baghdadi.subject: Indian Archaeology & Epigraphy
Al-Khatib al-Baghdadi.question: Al-Bukhala ("_____") in three volumes

Al-Khatib al-Baghdadi.fact: Al-Faqih wa al-Mutafaqqih ("The Jurist and the Student of the Law").

Al-Khatib al-Baghdadi.subject: Indian Archaeology & Epigraphy

Al-Khatib al-Baghdadi.fact: Al-Fasl li al-Wasl al-Mudraj fi al-Naql ("The Decisive Statement On Attributions Inserted Into Transmission").

Al-Khatib al-Baghdadi.subject: Indian Archaeology & Epigraphy
Al-Khatib al-Baghdadi.question: Al-Fawa’id al-Muntakhaba ("_____")
Al-Khatib al-Baghdadi.fact: Al-Fawa’id al-Muntakhaba ("The Select Benefits").

Al-Khatib al-Baghdadi.subject: Indian Archaeology & Epigraphy
Al-Khatib al-Baghdadi.question: Iqtida’ al-‘Ilm al-‘Amal ("_____")

Al-Khatib al-Baghdadi.subject: Indian Archaeology & Epigraphy
Al-Khatib al-Baghdadi.question: Al-Jahr bi _____ al-Rahman al-Rahim ("Pronouncing the basmala Outloud"), listing – as al-Daraqutni did in his Sunan – the proof-texts of the Shafi‘i school on this practice
Al-Khatib al-Baghdadi.fact: Al-Jahr bi Bismillah al-Rahman al-Rahim ("Pronouncing the basmala Outloud"), listing – as al-Daraqutni did in his Sunan – the proof-texts of the Shafi‘i school on this practice.

Al-Khatib al-Baghdadi.subject: Indian Archaeology & Epigraphy
Al-Khatib al-Baghdadi.question: Ibn al-Jawzi in al-Sahm al-Musib stated that all of the hadiths adduced by al-Khatib in al-Jahr – as is the case with al-_____’s proofs for the basmala in his Sunan – are either weak or very weak
Al-Khatib al-Baghdadi.fact: Al-Jahr bi Bismillah al-Rahman al-Rahim ("Pronouncing the basmala Outloud"), listing – as al-Daraqutni did in his Sunan – the proof-texts of the Shafi‘i school on this practice. Al-Khatib al-Baghdadi.subject: Indian Archaeology & Epigraphy

Al-Khatib al-Baghdadi.subject: Indian Archaeology & Epigraphy
Al-Khatib al-Baghdadi.question: Al-_____ fi ‘Ilm al-Riwaya ("The Sufficiency in the Science of Hadith Narration"), it is still considered to be the best work on the subject in our day and age
Al-Khatib al-Baghdadi.fact: Al-Kifaya fi ‘Ilm al-Riwaya ("The Sufficiency in the Science of Hadith Narration"), it is still considered to be the best work on the subject in our day and age.

Al-Khatib al-Baghdadi.subject: Indian Archaeology & Epigraphy

Al-Khatib al-Baghdadi.subject: Indian Archaeology & Epigraphy

Al-Khatib al-Baghdadi.fact: Manaqib Ahmad ibn Hanbal ("The Immense Merits of Imam Ahmad"). Manaqib al-Shafi‘i ("The Immense Merits of Imam al-Shafi‘i").

Al-Khatib al-Baghdadi.subject: Indian Archaeology & Epigraphy

Al-Khatib al-Baghdadi.subject: Indian Archaeology & Epigraphy

Al-Khatib al-Baghdadi.fact: Al-Qunut wa al-Athar al-Marwiyya Fih ("The qunût and Its Proof-Texts") according to the Shafi‘i school.

Al-Khatib al-Baghdadi.subject: Indian Archaeology & Epigraphy
Al-Khatib al-Baghdadi.question: Al-Rihla fi Talab al-_____ ("Travel in Pursuit of A Hadith") Riwaya al-Sahaba ‘an al-Tabi‘i ("Narration of the Companions From a Tabi‘i"), listing examples of this occasional case
Al-Khatib al-Baghdadi.fact: Nasiha Ahl al-Hadith ("The Faithful Counsel of the Masters of Hadith"). Al-Rihla fi Talab al-Hadith ("Travel in Pursuit of A Hadith") Riwaya al-Sahaba ‘an al-Tabi‘i ("Narration of the Companions From a Tabi‘i"), listing examples of this occasional case.

Al-Khatib al-Baghdadi.subject: Indian Archaeology & Epigraphy
Al-Khatib al-Baghdadi.question: Al-Sabiq wa al-Lahiq ("_____ and the Subsequent in Chronology") in ten volumes
Al-Khatib al-Baghdadi.fact: Al-Sabiq wa al-Lahiq ("The Precursor and the Subsequent in Chronology") in ten volumes.

Al-Khatib al-Baghdadi.subject: Indian Archaeology & Epigraphy
Al-Khatib al-Baghdadi.question: Taqyid al-‘Ilm ("_____ of Knowledge"), an important book gathering all the proofs that large-scale writing of hadith began in the time of the Prophet, together with particular caveats against it
Al-Khatib al-Baghdadi.fact: Taqyid al-‘Ilm ("The Fettering of Knowledge"), an important book gathering all the proofs that large-scale writing of hadith began in the time of the Prophet, together with particular caveats against it.

Al-Khatib al-Baghdadi.subject: Indian Archaeology & Epigraphy

Al-Lalaka'i.fact: His most famous teacher was Abu Ishaq al-Isfarayini and his most famous disciple was Al-Khatib al-Baghdadi.

Al-Machriq.subject: Indian Archaeology & Epigraphy

Al-Machriq.fact: Al-Machriq (Arabic: المشرق ALA-LC: Al-Mashriq 'The East') was a journal set up in 1898 by the Jesuit and Chaldean Catholic priest Louis Cheikho, and published by Jesuit fathers of Saint Joseph University in Beirut (modern-day Lebanon).

Al-Mahalli.subject: Indian Archaeology & Epigraphy
Al-Mahalli.question: The _____ was Egyptian scholar and jurist (c. 1389–1460 CE).
Al-Mahalli.fact: Abū ‘Abd Allāh Muḥammad ibn Shihāb ad-Dīn Jalāl ad-Dīn al-Maḥallī (Arabic: جلال الدين أبو عبد الله محمد بن شهاب الدين أحمد بن كمال الدين محمد بن إبراهيم بن أحمد بن هاشم العباسي الأنصاري المحلّي; commonly called Al-Maḥallī (Arabic: المحلي; 1389–1459 CE) was an Egyptian Sunni scholar. He was a towering Shafi'i jurist, legal theoretician, Quranic commentator, grammarian, theologian, and logician.

Al-Mahalli.subject: Indian Archaeology & Epigraphy
Al-Mahalli.question: He was a towering Shafi'i jurist, legal theoretician, _____ commentator, grammarian, theologian, and logician
Al-Mahalli.fact: He was a towering Shafi'i jurist, legal theoretician, Quranic commentator, grammarian, theologian, and logician.

Al-Mahalli.subject: Indian Archaeology & Epigraphy
Al-Mahalli.question: According to Ibn al-ʿImād, he was from the _____ of Taftāzān
Al-Mahalli.fact: According to Ibn al-ʿImād, he was from the Arabs of Taftāzān.

Al-Mahalli.subject: Indian Archaeology & Epigraphy
Al-Mahalli.question: He studied fiqh, usul al-fiqh, and _____ under al-Shams al-Birmāwī, with whom he remained closely associated in al-Birsīmiyyah
Al-Mahalli.fact: He studied fiqh, usul al-fiqh, and Arabic under al-Shams al-Birmāwī, with whom he remained closely associated in al-Birsīmiyyah.

Al-Mahalli.subject: Indian Archaeology & Epigraphy
Al-Mahalli.question: He also studied with al-ʿAlāʾ al-_____ārī and in the science of hadith, he studied under Ibn al-ʿIrāqī and Ibn Ḥajar al-ʿAsqalānī
Al-Mahalli.fact: He also studied with al-ʿAlāʾ al-Bukhārī and in the science of hadith, he studied under Ibn al-ʿIrāqī and Ibn Ḥajar al-ʿAsqalānī.

Al-Mahalli.subject: Indian Archaeology & Epigraphy
Al-Mahalli.question: From 844 AH (_____ CE) onward, he taught fiqh at the Barqūqiyyah Madrasa, and probably after 852 AH (1448 CE) he succeeded Ibn Ḥajar al-ʿAsqalānī in teaching at the Muʾayyadiyyah Madrasa
Al-Mahalli.fact: From 844 AH (1440 CE) onward, he taught fiqh at the Barqūqiyyah Madrasa, and probably after 852 AH (1448 CE) he succeeded Ibn Ḥajar al-ʿAsqalānī in teaching at the Muʾayyadiyyah Madrasa.

Al-Mahalli.subject: Indian Archaeology & Epigraphy

Al-Mahalli.fact: A scholar who kept away from the political authorities, he refused the offer of the chief judgeship made during the reign of al-Malik al-Ẓāhir Jaqmaq.

Al-Mahalli.subject: Indian Archaeology & Epigraphy

Al-Mahalli.subject: Indian Archaeology & Epigraphy
Al-Mahalli.question: He died on 1 Muḥarram 864 AH (28 October _____ CE) and was buried in his family cemetery outside Bāb al-Naṣr in Cairo
Al-Mahalli.fact: He died on 1 Muḥarram 864 AH (28 October 1459 CE) and was buried in his family cemetery outside Bāb al-Naṣr in Cairo.

Al-Mahalli.subject: Indian Archaeology & Epigraphy

Al-Mahalli.question: Al-Badr al-Ṭāliʿ fī Ḥalli Jamʿ al-Jawāmiʿ – One of the finest commentaries on Tāj al-Dīn al-Subkī's work on uṣūl al-fiqh entitled Jam' al-_____'
Al-Mahalli.fact: Al-Badr al-Ṭāliʿ fī Ḥalli Jamʿ al-Jawāmiʿ – One of the finest commentaries on Tāj al-Dīn al-Subkī's work on uṣūl al-fiqh entitled Jam' al-Jawami'.

Al-Mahalli.subject: Indian Archaeology & Epigraphy

Al-Mahalli.fact: It was published several times in Cairo and Riyadh.

Al-Mahalli.fact: Al-Ḥaṭṭāb’s commentary on al-Waraqāt also effectively functions as a gloss on al-Maḥallī's work.

Al-Mahalli.subject: Indian Archaeology & Epigraphy
Al-Mahalli.question: Kanz al-Rāghibīn fī Sharḥ Minhāj al-Ṭālibīn – One of the most popular commentaries on al-Nawawī's famous Shāfiʿī fiqh manual entitled Minhaj al-_____
Al-Mahalli.fact: Kanz al-Rāghibīn fī Sharḥ Minhāj al-Ṭālibīn – One of the most popular commentaries on al-Nawawī's famous Shāfiʿī fiqh manual entitled Minhaj al-Talibin.

Al-Mahalli.subject: Indian Archaeology & Epigraphy
Al-Mahalli.question: Several scholars, including al-Qalyūbī, Shihāb al-Dīn Aḥmad ʿAmīrah al-_____ī, al-Ṭablāwī, and Nūr al-Dīn al-Ḥalabī, composed glosses upon it
Al-Mahalli.fact: Several scholars, including al-Qalyūbī, Shihāb al-Dīn Aḥmad ʿAmīrah al-Burullusī, al-Ṭablāwī, and Nūr al-Dīn al-Ḥalabī, composed glosses upon it.

Al-Mahalli.subject: Indian Archaeology & Epigraphy

Al-Mahalli.fact: Sharḥ al-Qawāʿid li-Ibn Hishām – An unfinished commentary on al-Iʿrāb ʿan Qawāʿid al-Iʿrāb by Ibn Hishām al-Naḥwī.

Al-Mahalli.subject: Indian Archaeology & Epigraphy

Al-Mahalli.fact: Al-Anwār al-Muḍiyya fī Madḥ Khayr al-Bariyya – A commentary on Muḥammad al-Būṣīrī's entitled Qaṣīdat al-Burda.

Al-Mahalli.subject: Indian Archaeology & Epigraphy
Al-Mahalli.question: Aḥmad al-Desūqī later wrote a gloss upon it titled Ḥāshiya ʿalā _____ḥ al-Burda
Al-Mahalli.fact: Sharḥ al-Qawāʿid li-Ibn Hishām – An unfinished commentary on al-Iʿrāb ʿan Qawāʿid al-Iʿrāb by Ibn Hishām al-Naḥwī. Aḥmad al-Desūqī later wrote a gloss upon it titled Ḥāshiya ʿalā Sharḥ al-Burda.

Al-Mahalli.subject: Indian Archaeology & Epigraphy
Al-Mahalli.question: Sharḥ al-Burda (Sharḥ Bānat Suʿād) – A commentary on the Qaṣīdat al-Burda of Kaʿb ibn _____
Al-Mahalli.fact: Sharḥ al-Burda (Sharḥ Bānat Suʿād) – A commentary on the Qaṣīdat al-Burda of Kaʿb ibn Zuhayr.

Al-Mahalli.subject: Indian Archaeology & Epigraphy

Al-Mahalli.subject: Indian Archaeology & Epigraphy
Al-Mahalli.question: Ḥāshiya ʿalā Sharḥ al-Bayḍāwī – an unfinished gloss, a copy of which exists in the Beyazıt _____
Al-Mahalli.fact: The work remained incomplete, and one manuscript copy is preserved in the Beyazıt State Library. Ḥāshiya ʿalā Sharḥ al-Bayḍāwī – an unfinished gloss, a copy of which exists in the Beyazıt State Library.

Al-Mahalli.question: Risālah fī al-Qirāʾāt _____ṣar al-Hudā al-Nabawiyyah – an abridgment of a work by Ibn Qayyim al-Jawziyya
Al-Mahalli.fact: Risālah fī al-Qirāʾāt Mukhtaṣar al-Hudā al-Nabawiyyah – an abridgment of a work by Ibn Qayyim al-Jawziyya.

Al-Mahani.fact: His known mathematical works included his commentaries on Euclid's Elements, Archimedes' On the Sphere and Cylinder and Menelaus' Sphaerica, as well as two independent treatises.

Al-Mahani.subject: Indian Archaeology & Epigraphy
Al-Mahani.question: He unsuccessfully tried to solve a problem posed by _____ of cutting a sphere into two volumes of a given ratio, which was later solved by 10th century mathematician Abū Ja'far al-Khāzin
Al-Mahani.fact: His known mathematical works included his commentaries on Euclid's Elements, Archimedes' On the Sphere and Cylinder and Menelaus' Sphaerica, as well as two independent treatises.
